page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred at the top. Page number at the foot right, with a mark "(?)" beside it.

main_text.p: sium factum exulem - à Constantino primum; deinde à Constantio: alios etiam Episcopos Catholicos cùm ab hoc, tum ab aliis: sed non sequitur, ex eo, quod quis injustè facit, propterea non habere auctoritatem faciendi: hoc enim sequitur duntaxat, abuti eum suâ auctoritate. Et mox: Solent autem in facto variæ esse iplarum actionum circumstantiæ, aliâs bonæ, aliâs malç[?], sed eas circumstantias non decet attendi. Ejecit, ut dixi,

page.notes: The "(?)" at the foot beside the page number is not clearly a catchword or signature; it is left out. The "-" after "exulem" appears to be a stray dash, not a line-end hyphen, so it is kept as printed. "iplarum" and "malç" are doubtful readings; "malç" is marked [?]. Hyphenated line-end words: "de-inde" (deinde), "Catholi-cos" (Catholicos), "au-ctoritatem" (auctoritatem), "de-cet" (decet), and "ctoritatem" is printed as ctoritatem with a spaced line break. The "Digitized by Google" stamp is left out.
